title: ग़लत Bag / The Wrong Bag

location.description: Back seat of an old 1980s-style kaali-peeli taxi, right-hand drive, parked at the left kerb under a concrete flyover in a Mumbai-like city. Teal-green vinyl seats, cream towel on the driver's seat-back, lemon-and-chilli charm under the mirror, chrome pull-up lock knobs, shuttered shop with abstract red and blue neon on the kerb side, sodium lamps ahead and right, one dark sedan parked about 10 m behind.
geography: Right-hand-drive car parked at the left kerb, nose pointing along the road under the flyover. Engine off until b7.
Imran: front right (driver). Tara: rear left (kerb side), diagonal from him, so each sees the other in the rear-view mirror.
Kerb side (car's left): shuttered shop with red and blue neon. Front and right: sodium-orange street lamps. Behind: one dark parked sedan, lights off until b7.
Door-lock knobs stand UP (unlocked) on every window sill until the clunk in b6; from that shot onward they are DOWN.
Wipers are still until one sweep in b7.

time_of_day: Night, about 2 am, heavy monsoon rain; continuous real time, about 30 s, no time cuts.

tara.wardrobe_lock: Tara: Indian woman, 31, lean, warm brown skin, angular oval face with sharp high cheekbones; straight black shoulder-length hair, damp from rain, parted on her right, the left side tucked behind her left ear, the right side hanging loose to the shoulder; black kajal smudged under both eyes, no lipstick; one small plain gold stud in her left nostril; one thin plain gold chain at the collarbone, no pendant; charcoal-grey fitted single-breasted blazer worn open, visibly rain-wet and darker at the shoulders, over a collarless maroon silk V-neck blouse; charcoal-grey slim trousers; no earrings, no rings, no watch, no bangles, no bindi; short unpainted nails.
tara.static: Unchanged in every beat: damp hair with the left side tucked behind her left ear, gold stud in her left nostril, thin gold chain, smudged kajal, charcoal blazer wet at the shoulders over maroon silk V-neck blouse, charcoal trousers (never in frame below the lap except s02). No jewellery added or removed.

imran.wardrobe_lock: Imran: Indian man, 46, heavyset with broad shoulders, weathered medium-brown skin, heavy-lidded tired dark eyes with deep creases, thick straight eyebrows; thick hair cropped short, mostly grey with some black, neat tapered nape; salt-and-pepper stubble of about four days, no beard, no separate moustache; faded khaki cotton taxi-driver shirt with two flapped chest pockets, collar open at the top button, long sleeves rolled to just below the elbow; one plain steel kada (bangle) on his right wrist; no glasses, no cap, no watch, no rings, no chain, no badge.
imran.static: Unchanged in every beat: faded khaki shirt, sleeves rolled below the elbow, steel kada on the right wrist, cropped grey hair, four-day stubble. Sits front right (driver), faces the windscreen, never turns around.
seen_in: s07 (eyes in mirror, back of head)

props.duffel_bag: Tan full-grain leather duffel, brass zip and pull, rolled tan handles, dark brown piping, rain spots. Closed b1; open from b2 to the end, on Tara's lap.
props.bag_contents: Cut-newspaper bundles with tan rubber bands, illegible print. Seen only in s02.
props.keypad_phone: Cheap scuffed black candy-bar keypad phone. Off in the bag (b1-b2), ringing with blank green screen (b3), on call at her right ear (b4-b5), dead in her right hand (b6-b7). Screen never shown to camera except off in s02.
props.lock_knobs: UP until the CLUNK between s07 and s08; DOWN in s08 and s09.
props.phone_hand: Always her RIGHT hand. Her LEFT hand is on the bag in s01 and on the door handle in s08.

tara.held: closed tan duffel on her lap; left hand flat on top, right thumb and forefinger on the brass zip pull
tara.state: out of breath from running, mid-laugh, triumphant grin, looking forward at the driver

imran.state: off-screen in the shots (script has his eyes in the mirror; dropped, see creative_flags)

props.duffel_bag: closed, zipped, bulging, on Tara's lap

world.sedan_behind: parked about 10 m behind, lights off, not in frame
world.rain: heavy, on roof and every window

knowledge.tara: Believes the bag holds forty lakh and that the mark did not notice. Believes she is anonymous: tonight she was 'Nisha'.
knowledge.imran: Skeptical ('count it first'). Whether he already knows the bag is fake is left open.
knowledge.caller: Not on screen; he planned the swap, so he knows the bag is fake.
knowledge.viewer: Knows only what Tara believes; Imran's deadpan is the first crack.

tara.wardrobe: locked; only her lap in charcoal trousers at the frame edges in s02
tara.held: bag now OPEN on her lap; hands out of frame
tara.state: grin dies (not shown here; delivered by her face in s03); whispers l03 off-picture over the insert

props.duffel_bag: zip ripped fully open, handles fallen outwards; stays open on her lap for the rest of the scene
props.bag_contents: about twenty bundles of cut newspaper with tan rubber bands, illegible newsprint, two layers deep; no cash
props.keypad_phone: lying face up on top of the bundles, switched off, screen dull and blank

knowledge.tara: Knows the money is not there and that she was played: the swap was planned and someone left a phone for her.
knowledge.imran: Cannot see into the bag from the front; hears her whisper.
knowledge.viewer: Sees the newspaper and the phone with her.

tara.held: keypad phone lifted out of the bag, in her RIGHT hand at collarbone height, screen towards her face, back of phone to camera
tara.state: grin gone, jaw slack, brows drawn, eyes down on the screen, not breathing

imran.state: off-screen; urgent warning l04 (script has his eyes snapping to her in the mirror; dropped)

caller.state: calling: the phone rings, two rings, harsh and loud

props.duffel_bag: open on her lap, below frame
props.keypad_phone: ringing, screen lit plain pale green, blank, never shown to camera

knowledge.tara: Does not know who is calling.
knowledge.imran: His 'मत उठाना' / 'Don't pick up' is urgent: he behaves as if he knows, or fears, who is calling. Left open.
knowledge.caller: Knows she has opened the bag (he times the call to it).
knowledge.viewer: Registers Imran's urgency; first hint he knows more than she does.

tara.position: rear-left seat; s04 right profile facing frame right (towards the front), s05 front-on extreme close-up
tara.wardrobe: locked; in s04 the nose stud and tucked left ear are on the far side and hidden
tara.held: phone pressed to her RIGHT ear in her right hand (frame left in s05)
tara.state: s04 cold, controlled bluff (l06), cut off mid-word; s05 the bluff dies, eyes widen, gaze slips down and to frame left, a bead of rainwater at her temple

imran.state: off-screen, silent; may be able to hear her side of the call

caller.state: on the line, voice only, phone-filtered; calm, amused

props.duffel_bag: open on her lap, out of frame
props.keypad_phone: answered, at her right ear, screen against her ear (no visible glow)

world.rain: heavy; neon strongest through the rear-left window behind her in s04

knowledge.tara: Learns the caller knows her real name, Tara, and her alias for tonight, Nisha.
knowledge.imran: Hears her say 'Wrong number' and the name 'Tara'; what else he hears is unknown.
knowledge.caller: Knows her real name, her alias Nisha, the con, and that she has the bag.
knowledge.viewer: The mark was never fooled; the con was turned on her.

tara.position: rear-left seat, centre-right of frame, front-on from the dashboard
tara.held: phone still at her right ear (frame left of her face)
tara.state: stopped breathing, lips pressed together, eyes wide and fixed just past the lens, completely still

imran.position: driver's seat; seen for the first time, as an out-of-focus left shoulder, jaw, ear and edge of grey hair at frame left
imran.state: faces the windscreen, has not moved, has not turned; eyes out of frame

caller.state: delivers l08, whispers the last half; the line goes dead on his last word (three call-ended beeps)

props.duffel_bag: open on her lap, out of frame
props.keypad_phone: call ends on the last word; dead

world.sedan_behind: dark, barely visible through the rear window, lights OFF

knowledge.tara: Told to ask her own driver who he is driving for tonight: now suspects Imran, her partner of six years.
knowledge.imran: Whether he heard the caller is unknown. Shown unmoved.
knowledge.caller: Claims to know whom Imran is working for tonight.
knowledge.viewer: The picture lands Imran on the word 'driver'; the suspicion transfers to him.

tara.position: rear-left seat; s07 is her point of view; s08 shows only her LEFT hand and forearm in the wet charcoal sleeve
tara.wardrobe: locked (s08: bare hand, short unpainted nails, no rings, no watch, no bangles)
tara.held: phone lowered a few centimetres in her right hand (unseen); LEFT hand closed on the chrome lever handle of the rear-left door, frozen mid-pull
tara.state: looks up to the mirror; whispers l09 over the hand insert after the CLUNK

imran.position: driver's seat; s07 his eyes in the rear-view mirror, sharp, and the back of his head and khaki shoulders soft at frame right
imran.held: hands not visible (script: his hand moves on the door panel; shown by sound only)
imran.state: eyes already on her in the mirror: flat, steady, unblinking; locks all four doors

props.duffel_bag: open on her lap, out of frame
props.lock_knobs: UP in s07; CLUNK on the cut into s08; DOWN from s08 onward
props.door: rear-left door shut, handle has not moved

knowledge.tara: Knows Imran has been watching her and that he has locked her in.
knowledge.imran: Knows she now suspects him; acts on it.
knowledge.viewer: Sees the lock as Imran's act (his eyes, then the CLUNK).

tara.wardrobe: locked; white rim on wet hair, exposed left ear, jaw and both blazer shoulders
tara.held: dead phone in her right hand, lowered to jaw level
tara.state: eyes wide and wet, fixed ahead towards the driver, lips parted, holding her breath; does not turn to the lights

imran.held: turns the ignition key (off-screen, sound only)
imran.state: does not turn around; sighs l10

props.duffel_bag: open on her lap, out of frame
props.keypad_phone: dead, screen dark, in her right hand

world.wipers: one sweep (sound; windscreen not in frame)
world.sedan_behind: headlights switch ON, flooding the cabin white through the rear window; no face visible inside it
world.rain: heavy; raindrops on the rear glass flare

knowledge.tara: Locked in a running taxi with a partner she no longer trusts and an unknown car lit up behind her.
knowledge.imran: 'बोला था ना... मत उठाना' / 'I told you... don't pick up': he knew answering would change things.
knowledge.caller: Gone; whether he is in the car behind is unknown.
knowledge.viewer: Open questions: who Imran is driving for tonight (the scene's ending question), who is in the car behind, and whether the locks are a trap or protection.

notes: Ends on the unanswered question: इमरान आज रात किसके लिए गाड़ी चला रहा है? / Who is Imran driving for tonight?

checks.detail: Prompts already stated the right states, but the plate labels in s03, s08 and s09 told the model to match plates that show knobs UP, sedan lights off and no green glow. Exceptions added.

Looking back, the driver is frame left (s06) and the kerb window frame right (s01,s03,s05,s09); looking forward, the driver is frame right (s07); profile faces frame right (s04). Phone in her right hand throughout; nose stud on viewer's right when front-on.

fixed_in_shots_json: s03: plate label 'Match them exactly.' now adds the green phone glow as an extra light on top of the plate's light.
s08: plate label now says the lock knob is pushed DOWN, not standing up as in the plate.
s09: plate label now says the lock knob is DOWN and the sedan behind has its headlights on (headlight-flood light), not as in the plate.
storyboard_notes: one note appended recording these three changes.
creative_flags: b1 and b3: the script puts Imran's eyes in the rear-view mirror; the shots drop both (documented in storyboard_notes). The script's first visual hint that Imran knows something, his eyes snapping to her in b3, is now carried by his voice alone. Acceptable trade for a bigger first sight of him on 'driver', but the Script critic should know.
b6: the script has Imran's hand move on the door panel; no shot shows it. The lock is tied to him only by the cut from his eyes (s07) to the CLUNK (s08). Likely clear enough; check in the cut.
b5: script says 'back of Imran's head'; s06 stages him as an out-of-focus front-left shoulder, jaw and ear because the camera faces Tara. Documented; not a continuity break.
b2: the script cuts back to Tara's face for the grin dying; the shots hold on the insert and move the dead grin into s03. Documented.

s02: prompt shows 'a little of her lap in charcoal-grey slim trousers' but its FINAL CHECK says 'No people, no hands, no face', and style.json's continuity note says no shot shows below her lap. Tara is partly in frame with no sheet and no wardrobe lock. Left as is: adding the full lock risks putting a face or hands into a shot designed to be empty, and the trousers wording already matches the lock. If the frame shows anything other than charcoal trousers at the edges, regenerate.
Script on_screen lists imran for b1, b3 and b7; the shots keep him off-screen there. Any tool that reads on_screen should read it from shots.json, not the script.
Lip-sync: l01 (s01) and l06 (s04) play on Tara's face in a still frame. Known and documented; the rest of her lines are off-face.
English cut: script.en.json notes l08 may run short in English; the shot is 4.8 s either way. Confirm against generated audio before locking the timeline.
